summary.text: Antiquities tells the Brothers' War, which begins when the young brothers Urza and Mishra find a Thran powerstone in the Caves of Koilos and break it into the Mightstone and Weakstone, each craving both halves.

Their rivalry kills their teacher Tocasia and splits them apart, so Urza builds a kingdom in Yotia while Mishra unites the Fallaji, and with Ashnod at his side he opens a gateway into Phyrexia, which corrupts him.

At the Last Battle at Argoth Urza finds Mishra Phyrexian-corrupted and unleashes the Golgothian Sylex, which destroys both armies and the land, ignites his spark and plunges Dominaria into an Ice Age.
